workout.warmup: Your walk to the gym is your warmup. DO ramp-up sets on the Smith bench (light 8, then medium 5) before your working weight.
workout.coach_note: HEADS UP  training slightly under-recovered today (poor sleep + beer/pizza last night). AUTOREGULATE the heavy lifts: match your last numbers, don't chase PRs. If a top set feels grindy or slow, drop 5-10 lb and keep reps clean  no ugly missed reps under fatigue. Rope pushdowns pulled from arms (sore triceps). Hydrate with electrolytes (alcohol dehydrates). If burning cals is the goal, add 12-15 min incline walk at the end. Upper Wednesday, lower Thursday, then a weekend off (back ~Mon/Tue). This is only WEEK 1 of the strength block (started 7/14) — the weekend is just rest, NOT a deload, and the block continues when you're back. Keep pushing heavy next week; real deload comes after ~2 more weeks (early-mid Aug), then we return to the 10-rep range. Main lifts 4x5-6, accessories 10-15.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bench Press [HEAVY]
exercises.note: MAIN LIFT. You got 175 for 5/5/4 last time. Own all 4 sets of 5 at 175 today — that's the goal before adding. Ramp up first. Ballard Smith bar = 25 lb.

exercises.name: DB Shoulder Press [HEAVY]
exercises.note: MAIN LIFT. You OWNED 55 for 4x6, so bump to 60. Aim 4x5-6. Watch the left shoulder; ramp with lighter DBs first. PF caps at 75 so still room.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row [HEAVY]
exercises.note: MAIN LIFT. 160 was a clean 4x6 — go 165-170. Your best lift, keep pushing. Chest up, controlled.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown [HEAVY]
exercises.note: MAIN LIFT. Back to your neutral close grip (you tried the wide bar last time — it's harder, so numbers won't match). 150 for 4x6. Full stretch, drive elbows down.

exercises.name: Face Pulls
exercises.note: Don't forget these today (you subbed lateral raises last time). Rear-delt/rotator health, pairs with your band work. Gauge the machine by feel.

exercises.name: Arms Superset  Hammer Curl + Incline DB Curl (biceps only)
exercises.note: Pushdowns pulled today  triceps still sore from Monday's skull crushers, and they already get worked on the bench + shoulder press. Biceps only here: hammer curls + incline DB curls. Let the tris recover; pushdowns are back in next upper day.

exercises.name: Core  LIGHT / optional today
exercises.detail: Skip if abs still sore. If anything: 1 round Pallof Press 25 x10/side (anti-rotation only)
exercises.note: Abs still sore from Monday's squats + deadlifts, so no direct flexion today (dropped the hanging knee raises + bicycle crunches). Your core already braces hard on every heavy set. If they feel fine once you're warm, one easy round of Pallof press is plenty  otherwise skip it entirely and let them recover.
